crop_rationale: No text events in all 72 EDF annotation channels. First 60 seconds is a reproducible V1 bridge, not a verified task onset.

preprocessing.supplier_processing: Already cleaned by supplier; cannot undo or certify original information boundaries.

s1_gap_rationale: Conservative separation covering maximum planned 4-second window; no new temporal filtering. Recalculate support if adding filtering.
quality_policy: Report every file. Nonfinite data or wholly flat channel stops preparation. No score-driven exclusions, clipping flags are descriptive only.
failure_policy: Record failed status and exception; do not substitute predictions or silently drop folds. Incomplete runs are not a complete baseline.
scope: S2 is primary. S1 split manifests and isolation tests only at stage1. No target calibration.
